case: Kissinger’s July 2023 China visit: bounded old-friends and intermediary audit
event_scope: July 18–20, 2023; June/July chronology controls and November statements distinguished from the visit
publication_policy: Original analysis, metadata and brief necessary quotations in Git. Full captures and extracts remain outside Git. Translations, syndication and repeated official readouts are not independent witness counts.
source_independence: MFA/embassy documents share Chinese public-position chains. The MOD reprint and abridgement form one readout family. CNN adds one anonymous advance-notice report; much CNN/Reuters coverage repeats named official briefings. Carnegie’s Kissinger paragraph combines those public families with one anonymous retrospective interview citation. Blinken’s obituary is distinct participant testimony but ceremonial and nonspecific.
